title: Juicy Savory Low-Fat Thai Chicken Stir-fry
description: A savory and juicy Thai-inspired dish that features white vinegar for a zesty flavor with low-fat-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.notes: low-sodium soy sauce or tamari for a gluten-free option

ingredients.name: oyster sauce
ingredients.notes: optional, can be replaced with low-sodium soy sauce or tamari

ingredients.name: chili garlic sauce
ingredients.notes: low-sugar variety for a healthier option

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables (e.g. bell peppers, onions)
ingredients.notes: low-sodium vegetable broth can be added for extra moisture if needed

instructions: Preheat your wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides. Add to the pan and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side.

Remove chicken from pan and set aside. In the same pan, add a bit of oil if needed, then add minced ginger, scallions, chili garlic sauce, and oyster sauce (if using). Stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Deglaze the pan with white vinegar, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Bring to a simmer, letting it bubble for about 1 minute to release flavors.
Add cooked chicken back into the pan and stir to coat evenly in the sauce. Add mixed vegetables and soy sauce (low-sodium option). Stir-fry until just tender, approximately 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice or noodles.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
